## Offer draft
The app POSTs every new **modification** request to
`http://n8n:5678/webhook/offer-draft`.

The agent searches the web for part prices for that exact vehicle, writes an offer e-mail in Bulgarian and saves it as a **draft** through the agent API. Nothing is sent to the customer here: the owner edits and approves the draft in the admin inbox.

**Set in .env:** `N8N_OFFER_DRAFT_WEBHOOK_URL`
